name: BIQAE (Beta-Posterior Interval AE)
description: Simplified Bayesian Iterative Quantum Amplitude Estimation (BIQAE) baseline after Li, Vidwans, Wang & Soley (Quantum 10, 1962 (2026), arXiv:2507.23074): replaces union-bound Clopper-Pearson intervals with conjugate Jeffreys-prior Beta posterior credible intervals and local posterior MAP refinement. The paper's posterior push-through across depth changes is not reproduced.
